    The minimal quotient #

    Let D be a directed algebra whose indecomposable projectives are good, with unbounded indecomposables and dim e_y A e_x ≤ 1. A minimal set T' of points such that the quotient A / ⟨e_v : v ∉ T'⟩ has unbounded indecomposables carries point–brick data (exists_pointBrick).
